ai_tweets.headline: NVIDIA CEO: OpenClaw did in 3 weeks what Linux took 30 years to achieve
ai_tweets.detail: Jensen Huang called OpenClaw 'the most important software release' at NVIDIA's agentic AI inflection point keynote. Compared OpenClaw's adoption curve to Linux, calling out its 135K+ GitHub stars and explosive community growth as proof that agentic AI is the next platform shift.
ai_tweets.takeaway: When the CEO of the most valuable company in the world name-drops your platform, the ecosystem is about to get flooded. Expect more enterprise tooling, more skills, and more scrutiny. Lock down your security now.

ai_tweets.headline: Google makes Gmail, Drive, and Docs 'agent-ready' for OpenClaw
ai_tweets.detail: PCWorld reports on the Google Workspace CLI (gog) going mainstream. Google officially recognizes OpenClaw as a first-class integration target for Gmail, Drive, Docs, and other Workspace services. Published on GitHub with growing adoption.

ai_tweets.detail: First dedicated hardware for the OpenClaw ecosystem. The iPollo ClawPC A1 Mini targets gaming, content creation, and smart office use cases. Purpose-built to run autonomous AI agents locally.

ai_tweets.headline: GPT-5.4 leak: 1M context, 'Extreme reasoning mode', monthly update cadence
ai_tweets.detail: AI Leaks reports upcoming GPT-5.4 will feature 1M token context window, a new 'Extreme reasoning mode', improved memory, and better long-horizon task performance. OpenAI shifting to monthly model updates. Meanwhile, community sentiment on GPT-5.3 remains skeptical.
ai_tweets.takeaway: The model treadmill continues. Monthly releases mean your agent's model config should be easy to swap. Don't hardcode models — use OpenClaw's model aliases and routing.

prompt_hack.title: The 'Dropout Prevention' Config — Stop Your Agent From Going Stupid
steps: Add to AGENTS.md: 'Before ANY multi-tool operation, state your plan in 1-3 bullets. After completion, verify the result matches the plan. If it doesn't, stop and reassess — don't keep going.'
Add: 'When a tool call fails, do NOT retry the same thing 3 times. After 1 failure: diagnose why. After 2: try an alternative approach. After 3: report to the user.'
Add: 'Never chain more than 5 tool calls without a self-check. Ask yourself: Am I still on track? Has the goal changed? Am I in a loop?'
This prevents the #1 agent failure mode: the 'confident spiral' where your agent keeps doing wrong things faster and faster.
prompt_hack.why_it_matters: r/openclaw's top post this week documents the 'dropout pattern' — agents that start strong then gradually lose coherence over long sessions. These guardrails force periodic reality checks. Simple addition, massive reliability improvement.

community_build.title: Open-Source Agent Memory System — 5 Weeks of Production Lessons
community_build.description: A developer open-sourced their agent's custom memory system after 5 weeks of production use. Key insights: semantic search beats keyword matching, memory compaction is essential (raw logs grow 10x faster than useful context), and daily-to-long-term memory promotion should be automated, not manual. 27 comments of active discussion on implementation details.
community_build.how_to_replicate: Check r/openclaw for the full post and repo link. The architecture mirrors OpenClaw's MEMORY.md pattern but adds vector embeddings for recall and automatic compaction crons.
